reviews.review:
Welcome to the God-tier of third-person action games. This game is, in my opinion, one of the most underrated games ever and a great way to dive into W40k universe. Every fight is as satisfyingly bloody as the last. Sure, you could say it's repetitive, but I don't think that's the right word because it never gets old and you're always itching for the next kill.  The story is also suprisingly good, it's not one of the main draws to the game but it won't leave you disappointed (Other than Titus, I found the protagonists to be rather uninteresting - the antagonists are the highlights). 

     On a contrary note, don't expect too much from the technical side. The visuals are just ok but slight dated, and the default controls are odd, although you can easily change the keybinds and fix this.

     PS: Seriously, try the multiplayer. There's usually still a match or two up at any given time. If not, it's still worth waiting for a new one. The MP is great and deserves to be way more populated.

This game is DEFINItly worth your money if you want to feel like a space marine, the heavyness of your armour, the boltguns etc.
It can get very challenging sometimes and you will most likely find yourself destroying wave after wave of enemies and feel like a compleete badass.
That is for the singleplayer, the multiplayer however is only recomendable if you have an online guild or a group of friend to make a private match. The multiplayer cominuty if you go without friends is absolutely frustrating, thunderhammer and stalkerbolter spam only.
